notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.1[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now save the game when you close it by just exit game. When you relaunch you can continue where you left off! 
[*] You can now use your journal to keep track of the puzzles which makes it easier to solve them. Also you can keep notes there! 
[/list]
